content.raw:
Innocart

Innocart Mouse Transportation Cart

Key Advantages:

  • Easy maneuverability for transporting cages
  • Compatible with all Innocage® mouse lids
  • Convenient flat top-shelf for storage
  • Lightweight cart (170 lbs)
  • Full cage visibility

Product Specifications

Larger Living SpaceEach Tall Rat cage has a 9" (22.9 cm) headroom for more living space.3-columns, 8-row configuration325.8 in² (2101.9 cm²)39.7” W x 58.3” H x 31” DWipe down with approved cleaning agentsNote: The Innocart is not ventilated and is meant for transporting cages only. COMPATIBLE CAGING

Innorack IVC Mouse 3.5

A highly-controlled clean environment at each cage level. View Caging COMPATIBLE CAGING

Innocage IVC Mouse

Large mouse caging designed to house more than 5 mice, for use with Innorack IVC Rat only. View Caging
